executive_summary: The proposal submitted by QuickDash GmbH is highly deficient, failing to meet multiple critical Score 5 and Score 4 requirements. While it touches upon general concepts like a real-time dashboard and PostgreSQL integration, it entirely omits mandatory timelines, role-based access details, data migration constraints, support terms, and specific risk documentation. Furthermore, its pricing section is extremely vague ('~€50,000' rough estimate) and fails to explicitly confirm whether the first year of support is included within budget bounds, posing severe commercial and operational risks.
strengths: Acknowledges core intent to provide a web-based dashboard and direct integration with PostgreSQL.
Mentions inclusion of low-stock alerts and role-based access control at a high conceptual level.
weaknesses_and_gaps: Fails to explicitly address the 'no database migration' constraint, leaving database risk unmitigated.
Vague timeline ('a few weeks') fails to address the mandatory 3-month pilot and 6-month full rollout milestones.
Commercial pricing is provided as an unsupported rough estimate (~€50,000) without outlining first-year support inclusion.
Completely lacks required operational details such as RBAC tier definitions, SLAs, support terms, onboarding plans, and risk/assumption documentation.
